note: Milestone 70: section completion -- each filing's { checks, incomplete } map and its progress -- for every fixture and variant tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js builds, all nine filing identities. Recorded in 70L from the frozen copy of legacy-app.js's computeNavChecks() and getWardProgress() as they stood before 70D moved them (which that spec had evaluated beside the new evaluators, and found equal on every one); `results` holds each distinct outcome once, `types` each variant's label and outcome. Regenerate only for a deliberate, recorded change: PG_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js, and say why here. Changed by Milestone 71B (2026-09-29, attorney optional when none is entered): the Annual family's a-p5 and the Simplified s-p5 are complete with no attorney started (s-cover and s-p6 likewise stop requiring one), a-p10 requires the certifying guardian when co-guardians and no attorney, and the Minor Plan's pm-p7 follows validatePlanMinor(): each of preparer and attorney optional until started, then name plus a valid signature (the saturated variants, whose signature fields hold the literal Yes, now read incomplete there, as the validator reads them). New variants cover the fields 71B added. Changed by Milestone 71C (2026-09-29, a share is a percentage from 0 to 100): the D-1 to D-5 marks and Part VIII (a-p8) also need every share in range or blank, as validateAnnual() now says; the variants whose trust row is filled with the literal Yes (every saturated variant, and the two 'trusts one full row' ones) read Part VIII incomplete for that reason.
